policies.text: Corporate advisory qualification is fulfilled if a staff member completes 10 client meetings monthly, has at least 10 years of industry experience, or obtains an Advanced Project Management certification.

Priority concierge privileges are granted to a client who possesses a Certified Travel Executive credential, holds an Executive VIP Passport credential, or registers at least 4000 monthly flight miles.
Automated schedule maintenance authorization is granted to an agent with priority dispatch clearance having an annual administrative allocation of 40000 dollars or more.
Executive lounge eligibility is granted to anyone sustaining high profile standing who also receives dedicated trip arrangement.
Emergency expense voucher entitlement requires holding a Certified Financial Auditor credential.
Special event qualification is attained by completing 8 monthly client meetings, logging 4000 monthly flight miles, or authoring 5 research papers in a year.
Event coordinator clearance is conferred upon executing at least 25 quarterly event bookings.
On-site facility escort approval is granted to any representative maintaining an annual safety record of zero violations.
Tier-one standing requires a yearly client satisfaction score of at least 90 percent.
Custom itinerary coordination is recommended for any client holding premium client recognition who is simultaneously assigned dedicated trip arrangement.

High profile standing is maintained when an employee holds an Advanced Project Management certification while possessing 12 years of industry experience and securing a customer score of 4.5 stars or higher.
Senior advisor status is assigned to staff with a personal assistant service duration of 5 years or more.
Premium client recognition is conferred if an individual earns a customer score of at least 4.0 stars or authors 5 research papers in a year.
Flexible reservation entitlements apply to an account designated for tailored itinerary support.
Priority dispatch clearance is given to a premier coordinator standing candidate whose response time stays within 20 minutes.
Dedicated trip arrangement is provided for an individual having priority concierge privileges whenever monthly travel budget reaches or exceeds 2500 dollars.
Quarterly operational auditing is slated for accounts with flexible reservation entitlements provided weekly pending requests do not exceed 15.
Premier coordinator designation is awarded if monthly completed assistant tasks reach at least 15 or if possessing a Master Assistant Certificate credential.
Lead planner certification is bestowed upon securing a Certified Schedule Strategist credential.
Standard account servicing is assigned to any professional satisfying corporate advisory qualification.
